message: Here's what's working: the emulation recorded no test failures, and the end-to-end flow is intact, with collection, redaction, BigQuery, the Cloud Run analyst, Gemini and cited answers for the operator. It's blocked because the generator has no Google Cloud implementation for any of these parts: the only typed GCP contract is private object storage, and using it would shrink our app down to storage. So I'm not proposing a diagram change. A diagram edit can't fix this; it needs product engineering work on native GCP generators (Pub/Sub log sink, Cloud Run with Sensitive Data Protection, BigQuery, a Vertex AI call), and this report (artifact 2010777e…) can be the reproducer. Nothing has run on a real model, in a region or in a deployment yet. While that work is pending, here's the decision that most shapes those generators: which country must the telemetry and model calls stay in, for example "EU only" or "Australia"?
